title_tags: Keep titles between 30 and 60 characters. Put the main keyword near the start. Make every title unique.
meta_descriptions: Keep descriptions between 70 and 155 characters. Summarize the page and give a reason to click. Make each one unique.
heading_tags: Use one H1 per page. Keep it unique and under 70 characters. Use H2 and H3 in order to structure sections.
image_alts: Add ALT text that describes each image. Keep images under 200 KB. Use modern formats like WebP.
page_load_speed: Aim for LCP under 2.5 seconds. Compress images, defer scripts, and enable caching.
schema: Add Organization schema sitewide. Add Product, Article, Breadcrumb, and FAQ schema where they fit. Name every item.
url_redirects: Use 301 redirects for permanent moves. Pick one domain version and redirect the others to it.
broken_links: Fix or redirect every page that returns 404. Update internal links that point to them.
duplicate_content: Keep each page unique. Use canonical tags where near duplicates must exist.
ai_optimization: Answer the main question in the first lines of each section. Use question headings, clear authors, dates, and schema.
social_media: Post on each active platform at least monthly. Link all profiles from the website.
google_business_profile: Create and verify a Google Business Profile. Fill every field and post updates often.
nap: Show the business name, address, and phone number on the site. Keep them identical everywhere.
